name: David Yow
bio: David Yow (born August 2, 1960) is an American musician and actor born in Las Vegas, Nevada and best known as the vocalist for the noise rock bands Scratch Acid and The Jesus Lizard. Yow's debut solo album was released in June 2013 on Joyful Noise Records.

credits.overview: Follows the story of the groundbreaking Texas-based art-punk band founded by frontman Gibby Haynes and guitarist Paul Leary.

credits.title: The Toxic Avenger Unrated
